release.name: v0.11.0
release.body:
## Contents

Each tarball contains `bin/` with all mallcop binaries:

- `baseline` — baseline engine + CLI
- `detector-*` — 13 security detectors
- `mallcop` — customer scan CLI
- `mallcop-finding-context` — WorkContext builder with injection defense
- `notify-{telegram,slack,teams,email}` — delivery channels

## Install

```bash
# Download (replace PLATFORM with linux-amd64, linux-arm64, or darwin-arm64)
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
sha256sum -c mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
tar xzf mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
ls bin/
```

### Features

- feat(migrate): `mallcop migrate` upgrades an existing deploy repo in place (mallcoppro-973) (#163)

### Other

- backlog: default→triage (2b9), lookup_rules metadata schema (118), github_actor degrade (2a9), SHA-pin actions (796) (#164)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.10.1...v0.11.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0)
